basis: Standing operator delegation in docs/ASSESSMENT_TESTING.md, dated 2026-09-25 and expanded 2026-09-27, covers routine test-definition changes and finite amendments.
Current user instruction: continue investigation with a bounded offline diagnostic experiment.
authority.scope: Synthetic local diagnostics only; no campaign reservation, budget amendment, live service, disclosure, credential access, source change, test change, or historical-record rewrite.

source.source_scope: The verification source digest is the binding. Git HEAD is recorded separately because the worktree contains preserved uncommitted changes.

objective: Observe how the frozen Codex adapter wrapper and, if feasible, the actual ManagedHostExecutor outer wait_for distinguish returned TIMEOUT RawExecution values from raised exceptions, and what metadata survives artifact and cleanup stages.

adapter_wrapper.subject: CodexAppServerAdapter.execute from the frozen source, with its private _execute replaced by a synthetic coroutine and a fake transport and fake worker.
adapter_wrapper.progress_metadata: A fixed synthetic scalar JSON string with stage turn_completed and one boolean; probe whether the wrapper preserves it unchanged.

cases.artifact_behavior: If called, return synthetic data and record the call.
expected_observations: artifact is skipped
transport close and worker cleanup are called
wrapper returns TIMEOUT with error_type TIMEOUT and progress metadata
artifact output replaces the inner output
artifact digest and byte count are recorded
transport close and worker cleanup precede return

cases.artifact_behavior: Raise ConfigurationError with a synthetic message.
expected_observations: wrapper returns FAILED with error_type WORKER_ARTIFACT_FAILED and output None
transport close and worker cleanup are called
progress metadata remains available

cases.artifact_behavior: Signal entry, then await indefinitely until the outer probe task is canceled.
expected_observations: wrapper propagates CancelledError
artifact cancellation is recorded
transport close and worker cleanup run in order
no RawExecution is returned

cases.artifact_behavior: Skipped because inner result is TIMEOUT.
cases.cleanup_behavior: Signal entry, then await indefinitely until the outer probe task is canceled.
expected_observations: wrapper propagates CancelledError
cleanup cancellation is recorded
no RawExecution is returned

cases.artifact_behavior: Skipped because inner result is TIMEOUT.
expected_observations: return occurs after delayed cleanup
wrapper still returns TIMEOUT with error_type TIMEOUT
progress metadata is byte-for-byte unchanged

managed_host_outer_wait_for.subject: The actual ManagedHostExecutor.execute implementation using the same real CodexAppServerAdapter, start/ExecutionHandle path, fake transport and fake worker.

cases.synthetic_inner_behavior: Wait until canceled, catch CancelledError, and return RawExecution(TIMEOUT, error_type=TIMEOUT, output=None) with the fixed synthetic progress string.
cases.artifact_behavior: Skipped because the returned inner RawExecution is TIMEOUT.
expected_observations: actual ManagedHostExecutor wait_for returns the translated RawExecution
returned status and error_type are TIMEOUT
transport close and worker cleanup complete

cases.artifact_behavior: Signal entry, then await indefinitely until ManagedHostExecutor's wait_for cancels the ExecutionHandle task.
expected_observations: actual ManagedHostExecutor raises TimeoutError
artifact cancellation and worker cleanup are recorded
no RawExecution or host_progress is returned

limits.temporary_files: None; the probe script, definition review, JSON outcome, and concise findings are retained under this report directory.
limits.external_effects: No model call, Codex login, Docker, network, credential inspection, campaign mutation, source/test mutation, or historical report mutation.

recording.interpretation: Synthetic current-code behavior only. The probe is not historical proof and cannot explain or repair a historical campaign result.
